extracted.name: Tuna Fish Pea Salad
extracted.description: Tuna, canned peas, a little mayonnaise, and a couple of seasonings are all you need to make this super-easy salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) can chunk light tuna in water, drained
0.25 cup reduced-fat mayonnaise, or as needed
instruction_lines: Place the tuna into a bowl with the peas, and lightly stir to break up the tuna and combine with the peas. Add the mayonnaise, garlic powder, and pepper, and stir to mix well.
